topic: Genetic Information as Evidence of Evolution
key_concepts: Evolution is the change in characteristics of organisms over time.
DNA and RNA are genetic materials in the nucleus responsible for inherited traits.
Similarities in DNA and amino acid sequences suggest organisms share common ancestors.
Cytochrome C is a mitochondrial protein made of 104 amino acids and found in most animals.
Comparing cytochrome C sequences shows humans differ from rhesus monkeys by 2 amino acids
Fewer amino acid differences indicate a closer evolutionary relationship.
Greater amino acid differences indicate a more distant relationship and earlier divergence
Fibrinopeptide A and PCNA protein sequences can also be compared to infer evolutionary rel
Evolutionary trees can be constructed from amino acid difference data.
